name: Marketing site & growth
summary: The public face and the growth engine: an honest-claims register enforced in CI, one landing page on the real differentiators, a pricing page that says the money rules out loud, an SEO foundation and a content engine only we can write truthfully (ATS guides from captured DOM, a free deterministic ATS check, companies/jobs pages from the posting store), the missing /help, referral and creator/campus programmes that fit the margin floor, and first-party growth analytics.

epics.name: Honest claims & the marketing QA gate
epics.goal: One register of what we say vs what ships, rendered through one helper, enforced by a lint in CI — no fabricated testimonials, numbers, partners or browsers on any public surface.

epics.name: Positioning, landing & conversion
epics.goal: One landing page built on the real differentiators (the inbox that updates the board, you submit, the self-building profile), real product footage, honest live numbers, a phone path, a try-it page and measured CTAs.

epics.name: Pricing page & honest money
epics.goal: The money rules said out loud in one block, a full comparison table from the catalog, Offer JSON-LD, an org calculator and context-aware arrival from the 402 sheet.

epics.name: SEO foundation
epics.goal: A route registry feeding canonical, OG, sitemaps, breadcrumbs and JSON-LD; 404/redirects; llms.txt; Lighthouse and link checks in CI; Search Console wiring.

epics.name: Help center (/help)
epics.goal: The missing public help site: searchable in-repo articles, FAQ with structured data, contextual deep links from the drawer and the app, per-ATS 'what we fill' pages and the permissions explainer.

epics.name: Content engine: guides, free tools, programmatic pages
epics.goal: Content only we can write truthfully — ATS application guides from captured DOM, a free deterministic ATS resume check, application-question guides from aggregated labels, companies/jobs pages from the posting store, comparisons.

epics.name: Referral programme & social sharing
epics.goal: Codes, attribution, qualification after 7 active days, Pro-time rewards as entitlement grants, fraud rules, an admin view, and share cards designed to be posted.

epics.name: Campus, creator & partner programmes
epics.goal: Ambassadors on Pro-while-active, affiliates at 30% of the first 3 months with disclosure rules and a recorded payout ledger, a /campus page for career centres, a press kit, and the student discount if the user approves it.

epics.name: Growth analytics & the marketing funnel
epics.goal: First-touch attribution captured server-side at signup, cookieless route counts, a six-step funnel by channel, Consent Mode v2 for GA4, an admin Growth page and flag-based marketing experiments.

epics.name: Lifecycle email & newsletter
epics.goal: A three-email honest welcome series, a public changelog, a monthly product update to double-opt-in subscribers, consented dormant nudges and newsletter capture on content pages.

epics.name: Store listings & distribution
epics.goal: Listings generated from the register, Firefox/Edge presence linked from the site, a real-UI screenshot pipeline, a polite review prompt and a launch kit.

epics.name: Marketing site quality: tests, performance, accessibility
epics.goal: Playwright smoke at 390/768/1440, axe on every marketing route, a real image pipeline, cache headers for ISR routes and i18n-ready strings.
